policy: Publishable reports normalize only the absolute workspace prefix. Raw bytes remain at the listed ignored test-results paths; both raw and normalized hashes are retained. Gzip is lossless over the normalized copy. Duplicate copied source trees, build assets and profiles are omitted; source pins and mutation text are retained. Repeated residue-regression carrier dumps are retained locally by hash in local-carrier-reports.json, with compact verdicts in regression-checkpoints.json; this phase does not claim new privacy qualification. This is not a durable external evidence store or closure of Q-08.
